movie.title: One Spoon of Chocolate
movie.overview: After serving his country in the Army, Unique is falsely accused of assault and sent to prison. Once released, Unique sets up shop in Ohio to restart his life, linking up with his only surviving relative, Ramsey. There’s something insidious happening in this town, though, as its racist sheriff and his crew of similarly bigoted acolytes all have a knack for violence and share a gruesome secret pertaining to a recent string of missing young Black men. When they set their sights on Unique and turn his life upside down, the former soldier has no choice but to bring the ruckus down on the sheriff and his goons.

reviews.author: Leno
reviews.content: A less sci-fi version of "get out", the movie follows an ex-convict former military who goes to a small town in Ohio after his family, only to find the town crowded with white supremacists who harvest organs from the black folk. The idea was great but the execution subpar. The movie tried to hard to be iconic and a few dialogs are just ridiculous. Overall an entertaining movie but be prepared to cringe in a few scenes. The ending was also very disappointing.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: After being wrongfully imprisoned, an Army veteran moves to Ohio to rebuild his life, only to be forced into a dangerous showdown with a corrupt, racist sheriff hiding a horrific secret.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Following a wrongful conviction after his military service, Unique relocates to Ohio to start fresh alongside his last surviving relative, Ramsey. However, his peaceful new beginning is threatened when he discovers the town's bigoted sheriff and corrupt deputies are involved in a terrifying string of missing young Black men. When the violent lawmen target Unique and upend his life, the former soldier relies on his army background to fight back against the town's deadly power structure.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: After honorably serving his country in the military, Unique faces a devastating setback when he is falsely accused of assault and sent to prison. Upon gaining his freedom, he seeks a quiet fresh start in Ohio, where he connects with his only surviving relative, Ramsey. Unique tries to leave his past behind and establish a new routine, but he soon realizes that something deeply sinister plagues the town. The local sheriff and his crew of violent, bigoted acolytes harbor a gruesome secret related to a recent wave of missing young Black men. Tension escalates until the corrupt law enforcement officers turn their aggression directly toward Unique, completely disrupting his new life. Refusing to back down or be victimized again, the former soldier calls upon his military training and tactical expertise. Unique wages an explosive, high-stakes campaign of retribution against the sheriff and his goons. In a battle for justice and survival, he brings unrelenting force down upon the men who have terrorized the local community.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: One Spoon of Chocolate follows Unique, an Army veteran whose transition back to civilian life is shattered by a false assault accusation that sends him to prison. After serving his time, Unique moves to Ohio to rebuild his life and bond with Ramsey, his last remaining family member. His pursuit of peace is cut short, however, when he uncovers an insidious network led by the town's racist sheriff and his violent followers. The corrupt officers share a horrific secret linked to a series of disappearances targeting young Black men in the area. When the sheriff's crew sets their sights on Unique and turns his life upside down, the combat-trained veteran has no choice but to strike back with full force to protect himself and expose the truth.
